content: We split the dataset into training (9,731 questions on 1,470 texts), development (1,411 questions on 219 texts), and test set (2,797 questions on 430 texts). Each text appears only in one of the three sets. The complete set of texts for 5 scenarios was held out for the test set. The average text, question, and answer length is 196.0 words, 7.8 words, and 3.6 words, respectively. On average, there are 6.7 questions per text.
